_comment: This service builds with the DOCKERFILE builder, so Railway runs startCommand directly in exec form (overriding the image ENTRYPOINT) with no shell in between. celery is already PID 1 and already receives SIGTERM correctly. Do NOT add an `exec ` prefix here -- there is no shell to exec into, so the literal token `exec` is treated as the executable and the container fails with 'The executable `exec` could not be found.'
THE SCHEDULER, and there must be exactly one of it.
Beat only PRODUCES: it puts due tasks on the broker and consumes nothing.
So it needs no -Q, and it does no work itself -- if this service is running
and no worker consumes 'publish', posts still never publish.
Run this OR `worker --beat`, never both. Two schedulers means every periodic
task fires twice. periodic_lock.py makes that harmless rather than
corrupting, but harmless is not the same as intended, and the duplicate
still costs a broker round trip per task per tick.
Replicas: exactly 1. Beat has no leader election of its own.
